T-180 refactor draft: the six looks, before and after

The real page (builder 0ab6cc8, Coast Esses laid, the same camera), with one stylesheet laid over it: the spec draft (briefs/t180_ui_refactor_spec.md). Nothing in the builder was changed. What the draft does:

  • One radius scale (2 / 4 / 8 / 12 px by size) times one factor per look; square where a surface meets the window's edge.
  • Rows and buttons inside a menu or dialog follow its corner (outer minus padding), so they come out square.
  • At most one capsule: Export to Assetto Corsa, in the factor-1 looks.
  • No coloured glows: hover and an open menu keep the look's own resting shading; focus is a solid ring; no halos behind dialogs; small neutral shadows.
  • Glass stays where it is (the left column and the bars over the view). Density and spacing unchanged.

The dialog is built with the app's own dialog markup and styles (the words are mine, so nothing ran on the track). Click any picture to see it full size.

SIGIL factor 0.5: buttons 2 px, menus 4, dialogs 6

Glass factor 0: square everywhere

Aqua factor 1: buttons 4 px, menus 8, dialogs 12; Export the one capsule

Aurora factor 0.75: buttons 3 px, menus 6, dialogs 9

Skyline factor 1: buttons 4 px, menus 8, dialogs 12; Export the one capsule
